svg.text: Read in execution order: FROM and JOIN, then GROUP BY, then HAVING.
3 user-genre pairs survive: Mickey-Pop, Minnie-Classic, Daffy-Pop.
svg.title: Example 1: watch the table shrink
svg.desc: Read in execution order: FROM and JOIN, then GROUP BY, then HAVING. The table transforms clause by clause; rows the final clause drops are greyed and struck through, survivors carry a green check. Color key: grey strike = a dropped row, green check = a surviving row.
